 By Sneha Kulkarni , ET Online Last Updated: Oct 28, 2026, 01:39:25 PM IST Follow us Share Font Size Abc Small Abc Medium Abc Large Save Print Comment Synopsis
 Gold rate today: Gold prices have risen today, October 28, 2026, across major jewellers like Tanishq and Malabar Gold. Prices for 22k gold jewellery are detailed, with differences noted between major retailers. The India Bullion and Jewellers Association published their latest retail selling rates for various purities of gold and silver. A comparison with the previous day's rates indicates a noticeable increase in prices across the board. Listen to this article in summarized format
 Listen ET Online Gold rate today: 24k vs 22k vs 20k vs 18k prices Gold prices increased today (Wednesday, October 28, 2026) across major jewellers such as Tanishq, Malabar Gold & Diamonds , Kalyan Jewellers and Joyalukkas . The India Bullion and Jewellers Association (IBJA) also reported higher gold and silver indicative jewellery prices today as compared to a day ago. Before making a purchase, it is important to check the purity of gold, hallmark, making charges and other applicable taxes that can impact its rates. If you are planning to buy gold or silver jewellery for a festival, wedding or investment purposes, you should also check the best available rates of the precious metals.
 Gold and silver rates today (Saturday, October 28, 2026)
Here is a look at 22k gold jewellery rates from Tanishq, Malabar Gold & Diamonds, Kalyan Jewellers and Joyalukkas across New Delhi, Mumbai, Chennai and Kolkata. Also have a look at the IBJA’s 24k, 22k, 20k, 18k and 14k indicative gold jewellery rates and the 999-purity silver jewellery indicative price today.

 22k gold rate at Tanishq today
As of October 28, 2026, Tanishq's price of 22k gold jewellery is Rs 13,245 per gram across New Delhi, Mumbai, Chennai, Kolkata, Thiruvananthapuram, Coimbatore and Bengaluru. On October 27, 2026, the same variety of gold at Tanishq was priced at Rs 13,175 per gram.
 22k gold price at Malabar Gold & Diamonds today
As of October 28, 2026, Malabar Gold & Diamonds' 22k gold jewellery price is Rs 13,195 per gram across New Delhi, Mumbai, Chennai, Kolkata, Thiruvananthapuram, Coimbatore and Bengaluru. On October 27, 2026, the 22k gold rate at the same brand was Rs 13,135 per gram.
 22k gold rate at Joyalukkas today
As of October 28, 2026, Joyalukkas’ 22k gold jewellery price is Rs 13,195 per gram across New Delhi, Mumbai, Chennai, Kolkata, Thiruvananthapuram, Coimbatore and Bengaluru. On October 27, 2026, the 22k gold rate at the same brand was Rs 13,135 per gram.
 22k gold rate at Kalyan Jewellers today
As of October 28, 2026, Kalyan Jewellers’ 22k gold jewellery price is Rs 13,195 per gram across New Delhi, Mumbai, Chennai, Kolkata, Thiruvananthapuram, Coimbatore and Bengaluru. On October 27, 2026, the 22k gold rate at the same brand was Rs 13,135 per gram.
